messages.subject: Running Octave (Matlab clone) programs using Shiny?
parts:
In theory, I guess it's possible to also create web apps using GNU Octave (Matlab) via the RcppOctave package in R.  Has anyone tried this, and if so, any issues (esp performance)?  It would be great if it works in practice since I have limited knowledge of R but wrote countless programs in Octave.  Thanks.

- JJ
